nets.label: Pi P15 → BME280 VCC
nets.note: Deliberate miswire: pin 15 is GPIO22, not 3V3. The sensor browns out at ~1.5 V and looks dead. Validation must refuse to draw this.

meta.title: DEMO — sensor VCC on Pi pin 15 (MUST FAIL VALIDATION)
meta.intro: Regression demo for a classic Pi wiring mistake: BME280 VCC wired to physical pin 15 (GPIO22) instead of pin 17 (3V3). If this spec ever renders a diagram, the can't-be-wrong guarantee is broken.
